column1: # Checks whose failability was proved somewhere other than against the
# merge-base. One per line: the check file, a TAB, and where it WAS seen to
# fail.
# **A redirect, never an exemption.** `make e2e-new` proves a branch's new
# checks failable against the merge-base, on the premise that a check
# accompanies the work it tests. 2c-iii's seven check surface that shipped on
# 2026-09-18, five days before the branch that wrote them forked — so all seven
# PASS against the merge-base, and the target is right to refuse them. The
# premise does not apply; the checks are backfill.
# Every entry here is printed on every run and recorded in the verdict, because
# a list nobody is reminded of is a list that grows. The reason is prose and a
# reviewer reads it. `make e2e-new` refuses an entry with no reason; `make test`
# refuses one naming a check that is not there and one pointing at a
# retrodiction that does not exist.
# A check NAMED on the command line is never redirected — that run is the one
# proving it, and filtering it would make this file cite evidence it had made
# unreproducible.
e2e/checks/seeded/2c-iii-1-bundle-path.jsonl
column2: make e2e-retrodict: 1-profile-never-sourced
